messages:
sasha: Thinking through SDK-side A/B handoff — we need a simple, privacy-safe header handshake so clients can opt into variants and we can correlate telemetry. ideas?
priya: +1. Key constraints: deterministic bucketing, ability to opt-in/opt-out, no PII in headers, and a TTL so variants aren't sticky forever.
ben: What about a header set like: `x-redwood-variant: v2a` and `x-redwood-variant-hash: 1a2b3c` so we can validate on the server?
mateo: I like that but hashing on client can be inconsistent if user_id isn't stable. SDKs should fallback to server assignment if unstable.
linh: Agreed. Proposed flow: 1) SDK checks local sticky token/cookie; 2) if absent and user opted-in, SDK sends `x-redwood-optin: 1` + `x-redwood-client-id: anon-<rand>`; 3) server returns `Set-Variant: v2a; ttl=3600` header.
sasha: That works. Two questions: a) header names (short vs namespaced) and b) telemetry linking — we need a trace id.
priya: Use namespaced headers to avoid collisions: `x-redwood-variant`, `x-redwood-variant-ttl`, `x-redwood-optin`. For tracing, add `x-redwood-trace` (opaque id). Keep values small.
ben: Example SDK pseudocode for deterministic client bucketing: ```js
const h = murmur3(`${userId || anonId}:${rolloutId}`) % 100;
const inBucket = h < rolloutPct;
if (inBucket && optIn) setHeader('x-redwood-variant', variant);
```
mateo: Note: murmur3 on mobile native may differ across platforms. Recommend server-issued `Set-Variant` for final truth, and SDK should accept server header as authoritative.
linh: Privacy guard: never put raw email/username in headers. Always hash or use ephemeral anon id. Document this clearly in SDK docs.
sasha: Ops/guards we should enforce server-side: per-tenant cap (e.g., a single org can't get >5% of global canary), global max percent, and error-rate spike rollback. Also surface per-tenant rollout % in console.
priya: Console UX idea: slider + per-tenant override sheet. Show live metrics next to slider (p50 latency, error rate, token cost delta). Have a red automatic rollback toggle when error-rate > X or latency > Y.
ben: For telemetry correlation, servers should emit events with fields: variant, trace_id, client_id (anon), and stable model id. We can join traces in observability by trace_id. Avoid logging client_id with user PII.
mateo: Implementation edge-case: offline SDKs (mobile background) will miss server Set-Variant. We should allow SDK to persist variant assignments locally with TTL and include `x-redwood-variant-origin: sdk` header so server knows source.
linh: Also add `x-redwood-variant-reason` optional header for canary vs ab_test vs manual to help analytics grouping.
sasha: How do we handle forced rollbacks? server should return `Set-Variant: control; ttl=0` and SDK must honor immediate unset. Provide an SDK callback to surface forced rollbacks to apps.
priya: Tests: add an integration e2e that simulates non-deterministic client ids and checks server-set assignment wins. Add unit tests for header parsing and TTL logic.
canary-bot: Canary started for rollout_id=rr-2026-03-15-7 at 2026-03-15T12:05:00Z — 2% global, per-org cap=2% :rocket:
sasha: Good — please wire the canary bot event into the rollout page so product owns the timing. Also make sure the bot includes rollback link.
ben: Small ops ask: when variant header is present, add a sampling path in logging (1/100) to capture full request/response for debugging (PII scrubbed).
mateo: On metrics side, compute variant delta dashboards: success_rate_by_variant, median_latency_by_variant, cost_per_token_by_variant. Hook alerts to relative regressions (e.g., v2a success_rate drop >2% absolute).
linh: Security: disallow arbitrary client-specified variants for org-scoped rollouts. Server should validate that the variant is part of the rollout config for the org.
priya: UX note — add an 'explain' flyout in console that shows SDK onboarding snippet for each platform (web, ios, android) with header examples and opt-in toggles.
sasha: OK next steps: @ben write SDK header spec doc + samples, @mateo add telemetry fields and alert thresholds, @priya update console mockups with per-tenant caps and rollback toggle. We'll review tomorrow after prototypes. :thumbsup:
